siteDescription: Academic homepage of Shuo Cheng, an undergraduate student in Cyberspace Security at Hangzhou Dianzi University.
researchStatement: Understanding resources and states in dynamic network environments through reproducible experiments and clear problem formulation.
futurePlans: Resource modeling and scheduling in complex network environments
Dynamic resource management in satellite networks
furtherQuestions: How can resource decisions remain robust under rapidly changing topology and traffic?
How can data-driven models become more interpretable and generalize across scenarios?
How can network forecasting and scheduling experiments become reproducible and comparable?
